title: Expand all 8 zones with gates between each adjacent pair

Update _spawnZoneGates() loop from 'for gateZone = 2, 2' to 'for gateZone = 2, 8'
Update _spawnEggStations() to include egg stations for zones 3-8
Add egg definitions in PetData.lua for zones 3-8 (StrandEgg, WuesteEgg, EisweltEgg, VulkanEgg, HimmelEgg, WeltraumEgg)
